thread:
Anya: Heads up — got reports that the incident channel didn't page the oncall for the cluster alert 1705. Looks like automation didn't open the incident channel nor page the rotation. Anyone seeing matching PagerRelay drops?
SRE Bot: automated-detect: alertmux alert stream gap detected for alert_id=cluster-high-latency, ingestion->fanout returned 200 but relay_enqueue failed 503 x3.
Mike: I can confirm PagerRelay spikes at 17:54 UTC, 503 gateway. No obvious network change in infra graphs.
Jordan: quick check — alertmux logs show a recent tenant-flag flip that toggles "squelch_duplicates". There's a race where channel-join completes after dedupe check; if join delayed, dedupe marks page as duplicate and suppresses.
Anya: that explains why channel wasn't created/opened then pages got squelched. Did the channel-join fail or just slow?
Jordan:  join was delayed ~10s on the worker due to thread-shard lock contention. dedupe window is 15s so hit suppression.
Ops Lead: This is customer-impacting — some oncall didn't get pages for the timeout alerts. Start manual ringdown to affected rotation, please.
Riley: On it — initiating manual phone cascade for rotation "infra-rotation". Leaving a timestamped note for postmortem.
Mike: digging logs — relay returned 503 because of a short-lived auth-token rejection from pager-bridge. Bridge rotated signing keys last hour and alertmux didn't refresh cached signer.
Jordan: nailed it. alertmux's signer cache TTL is 3600s but rotation triggered earlier; fallback path incorrectly returns success to caller and dedupe marks as duplicate. Patch incoming.
Anya: mitigation plan? We need pages out now.
Jordan: temporary mitigation: disable dedupe for high-severity alerts and force channel creation before fanout. Command: `curl -XPOST https://alertmux.internal/api/v1/admin/flags -d '{"squelch_duplicates":false}'`
SRE Bot: action required: flagged dedupe disabled for severity>=P1. Also queued 24 messages for manual dispatch.
Deploy Bot: restarting alertmux-prod (version=2026.3.1) on node alert-03 to pick up signer refresh. cmd: `systemctl restart alertmux-prod`
Deploy Bot: restart succeeded on alert-03 (uptime 00:00:28), restart propagated to 3/5 nodes; rolling restart continuing.
Mike: after restart I see successful auth handshake with pager-bridge and relay enqueue ok. Backlog draining.
Anya: confirm pages sent? Riley, Ops Lead — did the manual cascade reach oncall?
Riley: manual cascade confirmed, last call placed at 17:58 UTC, got 3 ack responses from rotation.
Ops Lead: marking incident as live-mitigated. Customer impact: subset of alerts for two customers missed initial page window ~4-6 minutes. No sustained outage, but degraded alerting.
Jordan: root cause summary in brief: tenant-flag flip + join race + dedupe window + stale signer cache -> suppressed pages. Patch: tighten join path, add telemetry for join latency, lower dedupe window for cross-tenant bursts, and hook signer refresh on rotation webhook.
Anya: assigning postmortem: Jordan lead, Mike infra logs, Riley ops timeline, Anya stakeholder comms. I'll open retro doc.
SRE Bot: incident-id=INC-2026-170505. Auto-created timeline entry.
Anya: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: notify security for key rotation timing, add test to alertmux integration tests for channel-join latency, and add an automation alert when relay_enqueue returns 5xx > 3 in 5m.
Mike: creating an alert rule now.
Jordan: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/alertmux/pull/411 — includes signer refresh hook and dedupe opt toggles.
Anya: nice. Closing thread for live ops. We'll use the postmortem to capture action items. :white_check_mark:
